title: RentVault
creator: cherry / factoruuu
summary: November 23, 2026: Rental terms are fixed at creation. Both parties can confirm a full refund, owners can claim after the rental ends, renters can dispute within the window, and anyone can trigger settlement after eligible deadlines. A timely dispute always refunds the renter in full; the template does not adjudicate damage or split a contested claim. Deposit amounts and events are public. The creator reports twenty engine tests and explicitly states that the template is unpublished on Esmeralda and mainnet, with no wallet-connected frontend. Review covered the complete submission, README and MIT license metadata. Public app text extraction failed; app availability and operation were not established today. The recording shows the README with page scripts and downloads disabled. No wallet, funds or third-party code was operated.
cardSummary: Explore rental-deposit escrow rules with mutual release, claims, dispute refunds and deadlines in a walletless simulation.
